text:
Dylan: Anyone else seeing the p50/p95 lines swap places on the latency chart after the quota failover this morning? cc @Maya
Maya: yep noticed it around 08:12. p95 dropped below p50 for a subset of routes, looks wrong :thinking_face:
Lee: I pulled the raw samples for /v1/complete — p95 distribution changed shape right after the quota-failover event, but sample counts stayed similar.
Anya: can you paste the console panel query? might be a rollup or label mix on the pctl function.
Dylan: Panel query (approx):
```
SELECT quantile(0.5, latency) AS p50, quantile(0.95, latency) AS p95
FROM latency_measurements
WHERE route = '/v1/complete' AND deployment = 'prod'
GROUP BY minute
```
Maya: UI overlay shows p50/p95 swapped only when "show by deployment" is ON. When I toggle to "by route" alone the lines look sane.
Lee: hunch: our rollup path is merging samples from fallback routing (low-latency dedicated pool) without preserving sample_origin tag, so the merge mixes lower-latency samples into the main cohort.
SRE-Bot: Alert: quota-failover triggered for tenant-prod at 2024-09-12T08:11:07Z — routing_policy=failover -> dedicated-pool-2.
Anya: +1 — that fits. If fallback samples get tagged only at request-time but we rollup by endpoint later, provenance may be dropped by the aggregation pipeline.
Dylan: I grep'd the raw stream and found lines like: `route=/v1/complete latency=18ms sample_origin=legacy-proxy` then later `route=/v1/complete latency=6ms` (no origin). The aggregator uses absent origin => default to primary cohort.
Maya: Oof. That would artificially lower p95 for the primary cohort. We should treat missing origin as its own bucket until provenance can be backfilled.
Lee: Short-term fix: change rollup merge to treat missing sample_origin as "unknown" not "primary". That should stop the swap immediately. Longer-term: preserve origin label through the remapper.
Anya: Also worth adding a tiny provenance badge on the latency legend (hover) that shows sample counts by origin — helps product folks see this without digging.
Dylan: +1 on badge. Quick patch request: eng-platform issue with failing test due to label propagation. I'll open one and assign to Lee.
Maya: FYI this is causing some alerting noise too — SLO p95 on some routes fell (incorrectly) so paging happened. We should mute related alerts until fix lands.
SRE-Bot: Incident note added to #incidents: 2024-09-12 - quota-failover-provenance-leak (link: https://incidents.local/2024-09-12-001).
Lee: I'll do the rollup change now, test in staging, and push a canary. ETA 45m.
Anya: I'll prototype the legend badge after the rollup patch goes in. small UX: hover -> breakdown by origin with counts and percent.
Dylan: Thanks team. Action items: (1) Lee: rollup change (treat missing origin as unknown) (2) Maya: mute p95 alert for affected routes (3) Anya: legend badge mock (4) Dylan: open issue and link incident. :)
Maya: tagging @oncall to muted alerts. :thumbsup:
Lee: pushing canary now. will update thread when done.
Dylan: closing loop — canary looks good in staging, sample provenance persists. will monitor prod after canary promotes.
Maya: prod looks back to normal after fix. p95 > p50 again. :tada:
